apps.name: GymM8
apps.subtitle: Track workouts and gym progress
apps.localizedDescription: Plan workouts, record sets, follow progression, and review your gym history.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds Garmin set controls, weight/reps editing, vertical navigation, live heart rate, and calories/heart-rate measurements in finished workouts. Update the Forerunner 970 companion to 1.1.0 in Connect IQ. GymM8 saves a Strength activity to Garmin Connect.

Adds a Forerunner 970 companion: current exercise and set display, local rest countdown and alerts, and phone-controlled workout recording. Set up in Settings → Garmin after installing the USB watch app. Opening from the phone requires confirmation on the watch; finishing saves the Garmin recording and abandoning discards it.
Adds complete backup and restore, workout and exercise sharing, improved workout views, split arm and leg tracking, and reliability fixes.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: GymM8 connects to your Garmin to sync workouts, exercise details, and rest timers.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: GymM8 connects to your Garmin workout companion.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: GymM8 uses the camera to scan shared exercise QR codes.
